# Pratinav Seth

> AI researcher leading the Model Science group at Lexsi Labs (India & Paris). Works on post-training safety and mechanistic interpretability for language models — circuit-level weight repair, unlearning, and safety-drift auditing — plus foundation models for structured data. B.Tech Data Science, MIT Manipal (2024). AAAI Undergraduate Consortium Scholar (2023) and Mentor (2026).

## Pages

- [Home](https://pratinavseth.github.io/): Bio, research focus, selected work (CircuitKIT, SafeTune, AlignTune, CuratorKIT, C-ΔΘ), and a running news feed of recent publications and acceptances.
- [Publications](https://pratinavseth.github.io/publications/): 46 papers, pre-prints, and toolkits grouped by topic — safety post-training & alignment, mechanistic interpretability & XAI, tabular foundation models, climate/medical/uncertainty/NLP/vision work.
- [Experience](https://pratinavseth.github.io/experience/): Roles at Lexsi Labs, Mila Quebec AI Institute, Bosch Research India, IIT Kharagpur, plus research collaborations and leadership roles.
- [Talks & Events](https://pratinavseth.github.io/talks-events/): Invited talks, workshop spotlights, conference presentations, and industry events.
- [Education & Service](https://pratinavseth.github.io/education-service/): Education, honors and awards, academic service and reviewing, technical skills, and collaborators & mentees.

## Open-Source Libraries

- AlignTune: modular toolkit for post-training alignment (SFT, DPO, GRPO, RLHF).
- CircuitKIT: circuit discovery, evaluation, and application toolkit for mechanistic interpretability.
- SafeTune: audits and repairs safety drift in fine-tuned LLMs.
- CuratorKIT: provenance-grounded data curation and synthetic generation for LLM post-training.
- TabTune: unified inference/fine-tuning library for tabular foundation models across 7 architectures.
- DLBacktrace v2: model-agnostic explainability for LLMs and MoEs with CUDA acceleration.
- xai_evals: framework for evaluating post-hoc local explanation methods.
